blocks.text: MEXICO CITY — While the Day of the Dead is a centuries-old tradition in Mexico, its parade Saturday in the capital is a newer addition — with thanks to Bond, James Bond. The Day of the Dead, when Mexico honors its deceased by blending pre-Columbian traditions with the Christian All Saints’ Day, is historically a family affair. Relatives visit cemeteries and set up altars with food and other items their loved ones enjoyed in life. Then came 007.
